consensus_control.candidate_wells: CM control rows with vehicle == 'DMSO' AND qc_pass on plates that carry >= 1 TRAINING drug of the fold
consensus_control.forbidden: test/valid drug treated expression; held-out plates' control rows; adjusting weights after seeing test data
consensus_control.held_out_environment_rule: a plate whose fold drugs are all test/valid contributes no control row
consensus_control.name: CM consensus control c*
consensus_control.plate_mean: per-plate mean of log1p_cp10k over candidate wells

consumer_note: top-level structure/recipe/metric/loss/optimizer/prediction_noise/n_folds/seeds/lrs/dose_encoding are the canonical pipeline schema (ticket #4); the blocks below are the decision record and must not be re-tuned

data_contract.cm_expansion_set: eligibility_decision == exclude AND qc_pass (ticket #11 training only)
data_contract.cm_rows: QC-pass treated wells with a resolvable drug_key, plus QC-pass DMSO/Media control wells
data_contract.cm_train_control: mean over QC-pass DMSO rows on the same plate (never the mixed-vehicle control_mean)
data_contract.cm_validation_test_input: one fixed per-fold consensus c* (consensus_controls.npz); never a per-plate control
data_contract.deployment_semantics: validation/test/inference receive one fixed c*; the experimental truth is computed separately at scoring time
data_contract.eval_delta: y - mean(log1p_cp10k of QC-pass matched same-plate DMSO rows), computed only at scoring time
data_contract.tahoe_control: mean of the same (plate, cell_line) group's QC-pass control rows; never across cell lines
data_contract.tahoe_rows_used: ~is_control & has_structure & qc_pass & matched_control_ok (tahoe_usable); time never filters rows

derived_defaults.rationale: the spec requires a recorded seed, not a specific value
realises ~6:2:2 over clusters without a solver
the spec fixes three seeds, not their values
the spec fixes the mean-of-three-seeds rule only
equal plate weight is required; spelling it per well makes the pool auditable
the repo's existing plateau floor (05/03.1); the spec fixes factor and patience

dose_encoding.binning: none; the two sources' dose grids are not aligned
dose_encoding.label: FCFP4_bits * log10(dose_uM + 1)

environments.note: the builder writes the h5ad; the pinned trainer must read it (anndata 0.10.8 cannot write a dataframe/0.2.0 uns frame but reads one)

folds.assignment: greedy, capacity = ceil(n_main_drugs / n_folds) drugs per fold
folds.cluster_rule: connected components of drug_key <-> inchikey[:14] (salt/connectivity cannot straddle)
folds.excluded_drugs: eligibility exclude/uncertain receive NO fold (reserved for the #11 expansion ablation)
folds.plate_confounding: 459/460 temp_env keys sit on one plate; a fold's test drugs bring their plates. A drug split is NOT a plate split.

gene_axis.measurement_mask: var.gene_measured, per source; never a measured zero

loss_detail.note: a log-likelihood may be negative; never clamp or abs it

lr_selection.rule: per initialisation and per fold, choose the LR maximising the mean over the three seeds of the best validation AUPRC@200
lr_selection.then_evaluate: the three checkpoints (one per seed) at the selected LR
lr_selection.tie_break: lower LR first, then candidate order
lr_selection.tie_break_derived_default: the spec fixes the mean-of-three-seeds rule, not the tie-break

auxiliary: low-response / toxicity stratification (labels are all `unknown` in this round)
metric.condition: CM: drug_key x dose_uM; Tahoe: drug_key x dose_uM x cell_line_id
metric.headline: direction AUPRC@200
metric.name: direction_auprc
metric.per_condition_ap: AP_up = average_precision(y_up, pred); AP_down = average_precision(y_down, -pred); condition score = mean of the non-NaN directions
metric.replicate_rule: average predictions within a condition BEFORE scoring
metric.test_usage: scored once after candidate selection; never used for LR, epoch, seed or capacity
metric.true_set: top-k up and bottom-k down of the condition's mean true delta; stable argsort, ties by corpus gene order; a direction with < k non-zero genes falls back to its non-zero support

model_detail.objective: expression target: predict treated log1p_cp10k from (control, structure, dose)

prediction.repeat_inference_policy: byte-identical predictions for the same checkpoint and input
prediction.train_noise: N(0,1) noise vector of width 10 per sample, drawn from a seeded generator recorded per run

seeds_detail.derived_default: three consecutive seeds in the repo's 20261021 family; the spec fixes the count (3), not the values
seeds_detail.fold_seed_derived_default: study start date; the spec fixes only that the seed is recorded

test_units.candidates_formula: 2 inits x 5 folds x 3 seeds x 3 LRs
test_units.definition: one (init, fold, seed) selected checkpoint at the fold's chosen LR
test_units.policy: all 30 reported; no seed or fold selection; paired by drug_key

validation.cm: the fold's valid roles only; model input is the fold's fixed c*
validation.tahoe_pretrain: plate13 + plate14 valid (existing technical default; not a cold-drug claim)
